minutes.markdown:
# Minutes — Board meeting #4

**Riverside Commons vzw** · Sunday 27 September 2026, 19:00 CEST (17:00 UTC)
Held at the community hall, room 2, and online.

**Present:** Alice Moreau (chair), Ben Hartley, Chloé Varga. **Represented:** Dana Okafor (by Ben Hartley, written proxy). **Absent:** Emil Strand. **Excused:** Farah Idris. *In attendance:* Greta Lind, guest accountant.

**Opening.** The chair opened the meeting at 19:06 and confirmed the quorum. The agenda (version 2) was taken as circulated.

---

## 1. Approval of the minutes of Board meeting #3

The minutes of 30 August 2026 were before the board as **version 2**. No corrections were raised.

> **RESOLVED:** that the minutes of Board meeting #3 of 30 August 2026, version 2, are approved as the official record of that meeting.

## 2. Community garden: water supply

Ben Hartley summarised the two options. The tank can be installed within a fortnight; the municipal connection has no date yet.

### 2.1 Rainwater tank

Three quotes were compared:

1. Supplier A — EUR 1,240, delivery included
2. Supplier B — EUR 1,310, delivery extra
3. Supplier C — EUR 1,195, but *no* base plate
   - a base plate adds about EUR 150
   - the plate needs two people to lay

Chloé Varga declared that she had obtained quote B through a relative and abstained.

> **RESOLVED:** that the association buys and installs a 3,000 litre rainwater tank, within a budget of EUR 1,300.
>
> The municipal connection is reconsidered when its quote arrives.

### 2.2 Municipal connection

Still awaited (see action `A-1`).

## 3. 2027 budget

The treasurer presented the draft. Key points:

- income is flat at about EUR 9,800
- insurance rises by 6 %
- the reserve reaches *three months* of running costs by year end

Greta Lind noted that R&D-style grants ("innovation" budgets) are not open to associations of this size, so the <grant> line should stay at zero.

### Record of voting

| Decision | For | Against | Abstain | Result |
|:---------|----:|--------:|--------:|:------:|
| D-1 Minutes of Board meeting #3 | 4 | 0 | 0 | Adopted |
| D-2 Rainwater tank | 3 | 0 | 1 | Adopted |
| D-3 Draft 2027 budget to the GA | 4 | 0 | 0 | Adopted |
| D-4 Website to a new host | 1 | 2 | 1 | **Rejected** |

## 4. Website relaunch

Ben Hartley proposed moving the website before winter. Alice Moreau and Dana Okafor (by proxy) preferred to wait until the volunteer handbook is published, so the new site launches with it. The proposal was **not carried** (see the record of voting above).

## 5. Volunteer insurance

The broker's quote was noted. Dana Okafor will collect two more quotes before the next meeting.

#### Note on the renewal date

The current policy lapses on 31 December 2026; a decision is needed at the October meeting at the latest.

## 6. Any other business

None. The next meeting is on **Sunday 25 October 2026** at 19:00 CEST. More information on [the association's website](https://riverside-commons.example/board).

The meeting was adjourned at 20:52.

---

*These minutes were drafted with the help of Meet++ and checked by the chair.*
